'''Hu Joomi''' was a civil servant who worked in [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]'s [[Office of Ethics]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|I don't want to go into too much detail, but I received a report on untapped kolto reserves. The trouble is this report comes from the Empire. Given their recent activities here, I feel like acting on this information requires clearance from the Office of Ethics.|Go Kila, to Hu Joomi|<ref name="TOR:MtN" />}}
During the [[Invasion of Manaan]] they were forwarded a message by [[Go Kila]] from the [[Office of Extraplanetary Relations]] concerning reports on untapped [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] they had acquired from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They were sent a follow-up message where Go Kila half-heartedly suggested deleting the file. Hu Joomi responded, warning that as the Office of Ethics was involved, the best thing to do would be "misfile" the report. Hu Joomi later received an office-wide message from the [[Director of the Office of Ethics]], who told everyone to stop talking about the message less the press get involved, and suggested that they bury the report.<ref name="TOR:MtN" />
